note.value: Dwarf engineers are able to perform battlefield repairs. During the end phase, after checking if fires have spread, choose a location and roll a die. On a 5 or 6 that location is repaired. A ship with a Master Engineer may reroll this roll.
Dwarf fleets may not have wizards. If a dwarf ships is effected by a spell, roll a die, on a 6 the ship is uneffected. A fleet with an active Runesmith is uneffected on a 5 or 6.
Undamaged Dwarf ships may not be boarded.
